sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: VAT rates are 0% exports/basic commodities, 10% electricity, 15% telecommunications and 15% other goods and services
sources.quote: VALUE ADDED TAX (VAT) — Rates for VAT are as follows: - 0% - Exports and basic commodities - 10% - Electricity - 15% - Telecommunications - 15% - Other goods and services
